incidents.cause: failure of the flight crew to confirm the left engine throttle lever was at idle during engine start.
The overheating and arcing of the DC Ground Service Relay and Block Diodes component for undetermined reasons.
The pilot's failure to maintain clearance from an obstruction while landing at an off-airport site, resulting in a loss of control.

The pilot’s execution of a hard uncoordinated landing, which resulted in the overstress fracture of the right main landing gear (MLG) axle attachment bolts and the subsequent separation of the of the right MLG axle.
The pilot’s failure to maintain airplane control while landing in gusting wind conditions.
The pilot’s excessive descent rate during the final approach for landing and his delayed recovery attempt, resulting in a hard landing.
